      <title>California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state</link>
      <description><p>Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded</p><p>Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.</p><p>Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/19/baobab-five-trees-south-africa-dug-up-export-blocked-georgia-aoe</link>
      <description><p>The trees, intended for an unnamed buyer in Georgia, were reportedly dug up without the necessary permits</p><p>Environmentalists in South Africa are racing to replant five centuries-old baobabs after the 20-tonne trees were dug up by an exporter, who tried to ship them thousands of miles to Georgia.</p><p>The baobabs arrived at a reserve in Timbavati, in north-eastern South Africa, on Wednesday, where they will be replanted and supported by cables to help them recover. The trees had been stranded at a warehouse in Durban since July, when they were intercepted by authorities who said they had been moved without the necessary permissions.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/19/baobab-five-trees-south-africa-dug-up-export-blocked-georgia-aoe">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/women-girls-rights-rape-sexual-violence-africa-marriage-unfpa</link>
      <description><p>Almost half of women in west and central Africa cannot withhold consent, with girls worst affected, UNFPA finds</p><p>One in four women around the world have no power of consent if their husband or partner demands sex, according to a UN report.</p><p>In west and central Africa, almost half of women (45%) are not able to say no in their own marriage, while a third of women (33%) in east and southern Africa and in Arab states face the same predicament.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/us-sanctions-icj-judges-myanmar-genocide-ruling-israel-gaza-court</link>
      <description><p>A ruling against Myanmar could set precedent for court’s judgment on Israel’s actions in Gaza</p><p>Fears are growing that the US could impose sanctions on judges at the international court of justice, including this year’s <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/09/navanethem-navi-pillay-wins-nobel-peace-prize">Nobel peace prize winner, Navi Pillay</a>, if the <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/15/myanmar-rohingya-genocide-icj">court rules on Thursday that the Myanmar government committed genocide</a> against the Rohingya.</p><p>The ICJ has never found a state responsible for committing genocide, and a significant factor in previous cases has been how to prove “intent” in a crime defined as acts committed with the “intent to destroy, in whole or in part” a national, ethnical, racial or religious group.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/us-sanctions-icj-judges-myanmar-genocide-ruling-israel-gaza-court">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/18/european-commission-accused-sugarcoating-figures-egypt-loans</link>
      <description><p>Leaked documents raise questions about claims Egypt met welfare targets to qualify for €2.5bn in loans</p><p>The European Commission has been accused of sugarcoating figures to enable it to release funds to Egypt under a landmark pact with the authoritarian government of Abdel Fatah al-Sisi.</p><p>The charge relates to a €7.4bn deal <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/17/egypt-eu-deal-refugees-mediterranean">promised by Ursula von der Leyen</a>, the European Commission president, to al-Sisi on a high-profile visit to Cairo in 2024.       <title>Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/excitement-unease-haiti-el-salvador-troops-gangs-war-bukele</link>
      <description><p>Foreign combatants in Port-au-Prince welcomed by many after years of gang control but some fear offensive could exacerbate volatile situation</p><p>A bullet-peppered mural of the Haitian striker Emmanuel Sanon covers the facade of Port-au-Prince’s main football ground. But more than two years have passed since any sports stars graced the pitch.</p><p>In 2024, as the surrounding city was <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/news/audio/2024/nov/19/inside-port-au-prince-haiti-the-capital-where-gangs-have-taken-over-podcast">almost entirely captured by heavily armed gangs</a>, Sylvio Cator stadium – where football greats including Brazil’s Ronaldo and Roberto Carlos once played – also fell under criminal control, its dilapidated red and blue stands used as an outpost by fighters working for a gang boss called Izo. Haiti’s national team, the Grenadiers, found itself homeless and was <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jun/13/we-can-do-much-how-feeling-for-family-helped-end-haitis-long-world-cup-absence">forced to play its World Cup qualifying games abroad</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/excitement-unease-haiti-el-salvador-troops-gangs-war-bukele">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/race-to-be-next-un-secretary-general-exposes-divisions-among-world-powers</link>
      <description><p>Debate about dominance of permanent five members could reignite if major powers block Costa Rican frontrunner</p><p>The race to become the next UN secretary general could reach a decisive moment on Friday when a UN security council vote is likely to reveal whether the Costa Rican frontrunner for the post would be blocked by the big powers. If so, the setback will reignite a debate about the dominance of the permanent five (P5) members at the United Nations.</p><p>Rebeca Grynspan, an economist and UN insider who is from a family of Polish-Jewish wartime refugees to Costa Rica, has been in the lead in all but one of the eight straw polls of the 15 UN security council members since the first secret ballot was held on 30 July. Each member goes down the list of candidates, casting an “encourage”, “discourage” or “no opinion” vote for each candidate.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/race-to-be-next-un-secretary-general-exposes-divisions-among-world-powers">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Testing confirms presence of etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia</p><ul><li><p>Get our <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/email-newsletters?CMP=cvau_sfl">breaking news email</a>, <a href="https://app.adjust.com/w4u7jx3">free app</a> or <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/series/full-story?CMP=cvau_sfl">daily news podcast</a></p></li></ul><p>Three people who lost consciousness and were hospitalised in New South Wales after using certain vapes have tested positive for the unregulated anaesthetic agent etomidate, health officials said.</p><p>NSW health on Friday issued a public warning about vape liquids containing etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/20/vape-users-hospitalised-after-losing-consciousness-prompting-public-health-warning-in-new-south-wales">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/kyiv-russian-attacks-bridges</link>
      <description><p>Despite dodging tears in the tarmac, people are confident in city’s infrastructure – and will not worry about what has not happened yet</p><p>Mykola expects to drive his battered beige passenger minibus 20 to 24 times a day past the holes in the road on Kyiv’s damaged Northern Bridge that were caused by a Russian ballistic missile attack on Tuesday.</p><p>Buses are now the only motor transport allowed across the normally busy multi-lane crossing, though on their way into the city centre they have to skirt the tears in the tarmac, using the only functioning lane to get by.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/kyiv-russian-attacks-bridges">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Tourists are throwing fewer coins into Rome’s Trevi fountain – is €2 entry fee to blame?</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/charity-hit-coin-throwing-rome-trevi-fountain-caritas-italy</link>
      <description><p>Charity that collects the coins says donations are down by £200,000 after a barrier was put in place to restrict access</p><p>When Jeff Clinton, an American visiting Rome with his wife for the first time, found a US one-cent coin on a street close to Termini train station, he knew precisely what he was going to do with it. “I’ll throw it into the Trevi fountain,” said Clinton, holding the copper coin in the palm of his hand as the couple admired the landmark.</p><p>He was well aware of the tradition among tourists of tossing a coin over their shoulder and into the waters of the baroque masterpiece, in a ritual fabled to ensure a return visit to the city or make other dreams come true.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/charity-hit-coin-throwing-rome-trevi-fountain-caritas-italy">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Beating of Michel Zecler in 2020 sparked outrage over police brutality after it was caught on security cameras</p><p>Three French police officers who beat a black music producer they said was not wearing a face mask during the Covid pandemic have been found guilty of intentional, racist violence.</p><p>The <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/09/french-police-officers-face-trial-over-beating-of-black-man-not-wearing-mask-during-covid">brutal assault</a> on Michel Zecler, now 47, was caught on security cameras in his building in 2020 and triggered outrage in France over police brutality.       <title>Spain frees wealthy US-sought activist on bail as Irish police raid Dublin home</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/james-fergie-chambers-bail-spain</link>
      <description><p>Pro-Palestinian donor James ‘Fergie’ Chambers released as court considers extradition request</p><p>In a blur of events surrounding the Trump administration’s effort to extradite James “Fergie” Chambers, Spain released the wealthy US activist and donor on bail even as Irish police raided a Dublin house owned by Chambers and his partner, Stella Schnabel, acting on a request from US authorities.</p><p>Chambers’s case is the <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/18/fergie-chambers-stella-schnabel-spain-extradition">first known instance</a> of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas, an accusation apparently tied to an international money-laundering charge in the criminal complaint underpinning the extradition request and donations to organizations helping Palestinians in Gaza.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/james-fergie-chambers-bail-spain">Continue reading...</a></description>

France will seek European-level sanctions against Iran in response to cyberattacks on hundreds of supermarket fridges, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Tuesday, after accusing Tehran's Revolutionary Guards of orchestrating the October sabotage. Iran's foreign ministry said the accusations were "baseless and one-sided".

</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ef3af00a-dcbf-11f1-b34e-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/cb700a478b2bb0246e753a3e44c0a699e13978e9.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ef3af00a-dcbf-11f1-b34e-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/cb700a478b2bb0246e753a3e44c0a699e13978e9.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">efe09190-dcbf-11f1-9487-5f60e87d1ec6</guid><pubDate>Tue, 10 Nov 2026 04:33:54 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ef3af00a-dcbf-11f1-b34e-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/cb700a478b2bb0246e753a3e44c0a699e13978e9.jpg">© Abdul Saboor, POOL/AFP/File</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Top contemporary French artist Christian Boltanski dies aged 76</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210714-top-contemporary-french-artist-christian-boltanski-dies-aged-76</link><description>
Christian Boltanski, one of France's top contemporary artists whose multimedia works probed the meaning of mortality and memory, has died aged 76, a former museum director told AFP on Sunday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8bb5a986-e4b7-11eb-b34d-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/e857c10696aa723e38930cb9e30ea78aa32eb150.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8bb5a986-e4b7-11eb-b34d-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/e857c10696aa723e38930cb9e30ea78aa32eb150.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b7135ce8-e4c8-11eb-89be-005056bf762b</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Jul 2021 18:44:40 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8bb5a986-e4b7-11eb-b34d-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/e857c10696aa723e38930cb9e30ea78aa32eb150.jpg">© Miguel Riopa, AFP</source><dc:creator>NEWS WIRES</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>'Crumbs': French PM's 1.6% minimum wage increase fails to placate unions</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261109-french-pm-lecornu-announces-increase-minimum-wage-bid-to-calm-protests</link><description>
French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced on Monday that a planned 1.6% increase in the minimum wage would be brought forward from January to December after holding talks with trade unions and business leaders over the cost-of-living crisis that has fuelled weeks of unrest across France. The increase fell well short of the demands of unions, which have called for fresh protests in the coming days.

French far-right politician Éric Zemmour said on Friday that he would run in next year's presidential election, joining far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, who was runner-up to President Emmanuel Macron in the last two elections. Zemmour is campaigning on a crackdown on immigration, including a plan to expel unemployed foreigners even if they are legal residents. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">2e6bcd08-b33a-11f1-b960-e76b244d1c83</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:06:31 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg">© Emma Da Silva, AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French PM vows to cut public spending by €54 billion to reduce deficit</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260918-french-pm-vows-to-cut-public-spending-by-%E2%82%AC54-billion-to-reduce-deficit</link><description>
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said on Thursday that France will cut public spending by €54 billion next year to reduce the country's deficit. The announcement comes seven months ahead of the country's presidential election, and the government is wary of a new wave of demonstrations with a jump in global oil prices sparking concerns over the rising cost of living. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">61b975d6-b32e-11f1-ab9e-b5bbc83805db</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 07:23:41 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP via AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/20/global-stock-markets-slump-anthropic-ipo-ai-sell-off</link>
      <description><p>The Nasdaq lost trillions in value, with the AI startup’s IPO failing to buoy it as investors question huge sums being poured into AI buildout</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/19/who-are-anthropic-founders">Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn?</a></p></li></ul><p>As Anthropic’s stock dropped during its second day of trading, the wider stock market dipped with it. What exactly have they agreed?</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/nov/20/what-is-in-deal-between-uk-eu-explainer">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Union leaders from 19 countries urge reassessment of ties to Amazon, citing company’s poor record on worker rights</p><p>More than 30 labor union leaders from 19 countries are calling on governments to review their public contracts with Amazon and Amazon Web Services, citing the company’s poor record on worker rights and collective bargaining, in an<a href="https://uniglobalunion.org/wp-content/uploads/Amazon-procurement-letter-embargoed-until-nov-19.pdf"> open letter</a> published on Thursday.</p><p>“Amazon’s consistent record of disrespect for workers’ fundamental rights should disqualify it from being awarded public contracts – its behaviour is fundamentally inconsistent with the shared democratic values of our countries,” the union leaders wrote.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/labor-unions-amazon-contracts-open-letter">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Company insists Alice Huang, who is accused of being a Chinese spy, left business in late 2025</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo">Elon Musk joins 165,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/16/ai-sell-off-resumes-jensen-huang-discusses-comeback-nvidia-ceo-dollar-stock-markets-latest-news-updates">Business live – latest updates</a></p></li></ul><p>Megaspeed International, the company linked to the downfall of the Nvidia chief, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/jensen-huang">Jensen Huang</a>, says it is a “legitimate and lawful business” and has announced that its director, who allegedly had an affair with Jensen Huang, left the business in late 2025.</p><p>The Singapore-based cloud computing company on the weekend said it was “aware of recent media reports containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/megaspeed-company-breaks-slience-nvidia-jensen-huang-alice-huang">Continue reading...</a></description>

The latest information, news and events in France, Europe and around the world.</description><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/</link><lastBuildDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:02:58 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>France</category><title>Former PM de Villepin launches 20207 presidential bid with warning to far-right</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-former-pm-de-villepin-launches-20207-presidential-bid-with-warning-to-far-right</link><description>
Former French prime minister Dominique de Villepin has announced his candidacy for the 2027 presidential election, promising to restore France's international influence, tackle growing inequality and challenge the rise of the far-right. The veteran conservative also delivered a blistering assessment of President Emmanuel Macron's leadership, accusing him of allowing the country's political and social divisions to deepen.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bedb7fd4-e4ed-11f1-9e70-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26324386665816.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bedb7fd4-e4ed-11f1-9e70-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26324386665816.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">cf6f11fc-e589-11f1-b2ac-0d673b4c7b00</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:02:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bedb7fd4-e4ed-11f1-9e70-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26324386665816.jpg">AP Photo/Aurelien Morissard - Aurelien Morissard</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France must change or 'risk losing' overseas territories, former PM tells RFI</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-france-must-change-or-risk-losing-overseas-territories-former-pm-tells-rfi-manuel-valls</link><description>
France's territories outside Europe are a major strategic asset, giving it a foothold on five continents and in three oceans. Yet Paris has long been accused of neglecting the nearly 3 million people living outside mainland France, who face deep economic and social inequalities. With calls for independence growing, former prime minister Manuel Valls warns that France risks losing its overseas territories unless it radically changes its relationship with them.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5b00a846-f5b5-11ef-a324-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_36YE3UC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5b00a846-f5b5-11ef-a324-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_36YE3UC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c2eb5f78-e343-11f1-ac1e-392da9561c55</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:31:24 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5b00a846-f5b5-11ef-a324-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_36YE3UC.jpg">© AFP - DELPHINE MAYEUR </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French Greens candidate gives hard-left Mélenchon a boost in presidential race</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-french-greens-candidate-gives-hard-left-melenchon-a-boost-in-presidential-race</link><description>
French hard-left presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has said an alliance with the Greens "should be possible", after the head of the Greens tentatively agreed to back him, angering moderates on the centre-left. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/803220b8-e4e7-11f1-a2f9-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T085824Z-1059669313-RC2NXNA8BALJ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS-GREENS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/803220b8-e4e7-11f1-a2f9-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T085824Z-1059669313-RC2NXNA8BALJ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS-GREENS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">40b0fb0e-e4dc-11f1-a123-31d05317ef57</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:04:55 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/803220b8-e4e7-11f1-a2f9-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T085824Z-1059669313-RC2NXNA8BALJ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS-GREENS.jpg">© REUTERS - Tom Nicholson </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Depardieu and Houellebecq accused of gang rape on French film set</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-depardieu-and-houellebecq-accused-of-gang-rape-on-french-film-set</link><description>
Paris prosecutors have opened an investigation after an actress filed a complaint alleging that she was raped by a group including actor Gérard Depardieu and high-profile French author Michel Houellebecq on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec3acb0c-e4dd-11f1-9619-3935a39ed096</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:24:55 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg">REUTERS - Gonzalo Fuentes</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France probes suspected leaks from interior ministry to far-right National Rally</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leaks-from-interior-ministry-to-far-right-national-rally</link><description>
France has opened a probe into suspicions that a senior official at the interior ministry leaked secret information to the far-right National Rally (RN) party, which is itself facing a number of investigations, prosecutors have said.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5be0a25a-e4b2-11f1-be46-714476ef8919</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:55:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg">© Pascal Guyot / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French union leader warns strikes will continue without higher wages</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-french-union-leader-warns-strikes-will-continue-without-higher-wages-cgt-sophie-binet-interview</link><description>
French trade unions have promised to call more strikes and demonstrations, arguing that a government proposal to increase the minimum wage fails to address the social crisis that has spurred protests across the country. Sophie Binet, head of the CGT union, says even after six weeks of action, workers and students are more determined than ever to keep up the fight.

</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f166e312-df75-11f1-adbe-29048b396e03/w:1024/p:16x9/AP25317657554123.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f166e312-df75-11f1-adbe-29048b396e03/w:1024/p:16x9/AP25317657554123.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">a235f704-df5e-11f1-bb2c-85a37d07b862</guid><pubDate>Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:08:48 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f166e312-df75-11f1-adbe-29048b396e03/w:1024/p:16x9/AP25317657554123.jpg">AP - Emma Da Silva</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France slams Russian ‘intimidation’ as fresh EU sanctions come into force</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261113-france-slams-russian-intimidation-fedorova-as-fresh-eu-sanctions-come-into-force</link><description>

He also warned that Paris would not be intimidated by Moscow’s decision to ban two French journalists and two MPs from entering the country.

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/dele-alli-tottenham-mk-dons-england</link>
      <description><p>The 30-year-old former England star combines Twitch streaming with working to return to the top as a player</p><p>Consider the training regime Dele Alli has followed since he left Como 18 months ago and it becomes clear why he takes exception to suggestions he has given up on football in favour of becoming an internet personality.</p><p>He trains five or six days a week with Connor Peters, an elite performance coach who has worked with players including Trevoh Chalobah. They spend four days on the pitch and days in between in the gym. A typical day begins at 9am with an hour of activation and stretching before Dele heads to non-league Windsor &amp; Eton at 11am, where he trains on the pitches and uses the facilities.       <description><p>Argentinian has excelled in man-management – but will need his powers to energise new squad and impress owners</p><p>Mauricio Pochettino celebrated his 50th birthday in style.       <description><p>Germany forward on her new life in London and drawing strength from the memory of her late brother, Dennis</p><p>Lisa Baum is 19, for the next few days at least, but you wouldn’t know it.       <title>Washington Spirit provide hope and joy in a city that badly needs it</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/washington-spirit-provide-hope-and-joy-in-a-city-that-badly-needs-it</link>
      <description><p>Spirit’s run to the NWSL Championship final is in part based on a positive connection with fans at a time when DC is troubled in more ways than one</p><p>In the moments after the Washington Spirit’s 2-1 semi-final victory over the Utah Royals last weekend, all of Audi Field was in rapture. In the stands, around 20,000 Spirit supporters had filled the stadium to capacity, the sixth time they’d done so in 2026. They filled the place with the type of wondrous noise that’s become alien in DC sports in recent years, the type of gleeful adoration reserved for the city’s rare winners. The Spirit will return to their home stadium to face the Kansas City Current in the NWSL championship this Saturday.</p><p>In short order, the Spirit’s players made their way to the north end of the stadium, taking their celebrations into the crowd with their supporters. Perhaps no player has done more to push the Spirit into not only local but national relevance than US women’s national team forward Trinity Rodman, and Rodman herself grabbed a flag from a fan, jubilantly waving it above the crowd. Moments later, she bolted back onto the field and track down the club’s owner, Michele Kang, cajoling the businesswoman into a celebratory dance.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/washington-spirit-provide-hope-and-joy-in-a-city-that-badly-needs-it">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Premier League: 10 things to look out for this weekend</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/premier-league-10-things-to-look-out-for-this-weekend</link>
      <description><p>Bruno Guimarães to feel the heat on Tyneside, Alex Scott’s return further cheers Cherries and Manchester City face favourite whipping boys</p><p>After three Premier League defeats on the spin, Manchester City need something or someone to come along and put some pep in their step, and Fulham look like just the thing – after all, in the past 15 years these teams have played 20 times in all competitions, and City have won precisely 20 of those games. Their current run of 17 successive league wins against Fulham is the longest run of victories by one club against a single opponent in English top-flight history. It is a reflection of the changing realities of English football, and the gulf that has opened between the teams that dominate it and those who seek to challenge them, that of the top 10 such runs all but one occurred in whole or in part after 2010 and six of them have been achieved by Sheikh Mansour’s Manchester City, with Chelsea responsible for another two, Manchester United one, and Portsmouth’s postwar, 13-game supremacy over Everton – a wild ride that included two 5-0s, a 5-1, a 6-3 and a 7-0 – the anomaly. <strong>Simon Burnton</strong></p><p><em>Manchester City v Fulham, Saturday 12.30pm (all times GMT)</em></p><p><em>Aston Villa v Sunderland, Saturday 3pm</em></p><p><em>Bournemouth v Nottingham Forest, Saturday 3pm</em></p><p><em>Chelsea v Leeds</em><em>, Saturday 3pm</em></p><p><em>Coventry v Crystal Palace, Saturday 3pm</em></p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/premier-league-10-things-to-look-out-for-this-weekend">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Thomas Frank admits he has a point to prove after taking reins at Crystal Palace</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/thomas-frank-crystal-palace-premier-league</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Dane was sacked by Tottenham in February</p></li><li><p>‘I know what I want and the direction we should go in’</p></li></ul><p>Thomas Frank has admitted he has a point to prove on his return to management as he aims to steer Crystal Palace away from relegation trouble after taking over from Pierre Sage.</p><p>The Dane was <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/16/thomas-frank-confirmed-crystal-palace-manager-pierre-sage">confirmed as manager on Monday</a> with Palace at the bottom of the table after 10 matches having conceded 24 goals – the most in the Premier League. They face a crucial trip to Coventry on Saturday and Frank said he had been “surprised about how good it feels” after returning to work for the first time since <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/feb/11/tottenhams-soaring-dreams-for-thomas-frank-quickly-hit-the-buffers-of-grim-reality">being sacked by <sup>­</sup>Tottenham in February</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/thomas-frank-crystal-palace-premier-league">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Gonzalo García: ‘I love Craven Cottage – the fans can reach out and touch you’</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/gonzalo-garcia-fulham-spain-premier-leaue-interview</link>
      <description><p>Spain Under-21 striker admits the pace of the Premier League has surprised him but says he must stay calm over goal drought at Fulham</p><p>The first thing Rita Hayworth’s great nephew says when he walks in is: “Sorry I’m late.” Gonzalo García is not late, but it’s very like him: he is impeccably polite, accommodating, and there’s an almost gentle quality to him, a calm that’s not common but can help, especially in moments when the pressure builds. There’s a reason one of the coaches standing in the rain by the pitch where Spain’s under‑21s have just finished training says everyone here loves García. The Fulham striker shakes hands, introduces himself and ducks into the dressing room to change; then a few minutes later he’s back, apologising for a wait that wasn’t one.</p><p>Time to talk, so let’s start with Tinseltown, the family tale. García laughs. His great-aunt, born Margarita Carmen Cansino, was among the biggest stars in Hollywood, although he’s not sure he’s seen any of her films. His grandfather was a surgeon and others in the family followed. His uncles played rugby for Spain, but that wasn’t his thing. As for him, he enrolled in a degree in business management and analytics, and reckons he might have liked law, yet even that wasn’t his chosen field.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/gonzalo-garcia-fulham-spain-premier-leaue-interview">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Summer signings join Lionel Messi among MLS’s top earners: Takeaways from the league’s salary release</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/mls-salary-release-lionel-messi-spent-per-point</link>
      <description><p>How much in player salaries did it take to earn a point in the 2026 MLS regular season? The latest batch of salaries lends some insight</p><p>Lionel Messi has closer company at the top of MLS’s list of highest-paid players, thanks to another pair of former Barcelona attackers. The Inter Miami captain is still comfortably the league’s top earner, on a guaranteed compensation of $28.3m. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire) and Antoine Griezmann (Orlando City) have entered the list with the second and third highest wages, while Atlanta United’s Breel Embolo, another summer signing, ranks fifth on a guaranteed compensation of $10.8m. Second-year LAFC forward Son Heung-min sits fourth on $11.2m.</p><p>Casimiro, who joined Messi in Miami at the end of his contract with Manchester United, is his team’s fourth top-earner with a guaranteed compensation of $3.54m. This comes after Miami announced his signing as a non-designated player to the surprise of some as the Brazilian arrived on a Bosman transfer rather than a loan-with-purchase, as Rodrigo De Paul had last summer, to keep Miami rules compliant. The MLS Players’ Association lists Casimiro on a base salary of $896,004.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/mls-salary-release-lionel-messi-spent-per-point">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>‘When I walked for Burberry I met Kanye West’: the two lives of Bromley footballer Omar Sowunmi</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/18/omar-sowunmi-bromley-footballer-model-kanye-west</link>
      <description><p>Full-time defender and part-time model, the 31-year-old is happy to shine a light on both sides of his dual career</p><p>“I was walking down the street one day and someone came up to me and said: ‘I think you should be a model,’” the Bromley defender Omar Sowunmi says. He was already living out many people’s dreams as a professional footballer but was able to assume an alter ego in the world of fashion. There are few parallels between the grind of lower-league football and Milan fashion week but the 31-year-old is adept in both worlds.</p><p>Sowunmi’s dual career mixes trips to Doncaster with visits to Paris. On Saturday Bromley travel to Reading under their new manager, Karl Robinson, as they attempt to move off the bottom of League One and the centre-back is clear where his focus lies even after his chance encounter with a model agency employee expanded his horizons.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/18/omar-sowunmi-bromley-footballer-model-kanye-west">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Inside women’s football’s difficult rise in Syria: ‘A joy that everyone in the country needed’</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/syria-womens-football</link>
      <description><p>A 14-year civil war ravaged the country and ground women’s football to a halt. Today, the first glimmers of hope are beginning to emerge amid difficulty</p><p>In December 2024, Syria’s under-18 women’s football team boarded a last-minute bus at midnight from Aqaba, bound for Damascus. The players had been in Jordan preparing for their final match of the WAFF women’s championship, where a win against Saudi Arabia would have kept their hopes of winning the title alive. Syria pulled out amid fears that the border would close.</p><p>Back home, a war that had been largely frozen for four years was suddenly moving at pace. Rebel forces had swept out of the northwest, taking Aleppo and were pushing south towards the capital, 350km away, threatening to topple the now-former president, Bashar al-Assad. Players from the provinces around Damascus made their way home. But those from Hasakah, in the country’s far north-east, spent the next three days stranded at Damascus airport, as airline staff fled and planes sat idle on the tarmac, until a bus was finally able to take them home.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/syria-womens-football">Continue reading...</a></description>

</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6bc2a808-e59d-11f1-af00-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-120826-121022-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6bc2a808-e59d-11f1-af00-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-120826-121022-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">708e9ae0-e59d-11f1-890e-577b54b17e92</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:20:15 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Le Danemark accuse la Russie d'avoir tenté d'assassiner un rappeur ukrainien</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261121-le-danemark-accuse-la-russie-d-avoir-tent%C3%A9-d-assassiner-un-rappeur-ukrainien</link><description>
Grand appui de l'Ukraine, le Danemark a accusé Moscou d'avoir fomenté une tentative d'assassinat d'un rappeur ukrainien sur son sol et va expulser l'attaché de défense de l'ambassade de Russie.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/7b5f0e1a-e59c-11f1-9110-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-110144-110333-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/7b5f0e1a-e59c-11f1-9110-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-110144-110333-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8060ddc6-e59c-11f1-b750-031be8b31adc</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:14:58 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Yémen - Arabie saoudite : nouvel échange de frappes entre les deux pays</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261121-y%C3%A9men-arabie-saoudite-nouvel-%C3%A9change-de-frappes-entre-les-deux-pays</link><description>
Les forces saoudiennes ont indiqué samedi 21 novembre avoir abattu trois missiles balistiques tirés par les Houthis yéménites pro-iraniens en direction de Riyad, au lendemain de frappes menées par l'Arabie saoudite au Yémen contre un port stratégique de la mer Rouge.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c1a8affc-e59c-11f1-b1d1-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-110805-110929-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c1a8affc-e59c-11f1-b1d1-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-110805-110929-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c6584832-e59c-11f1-a368-c13ccbc1cd4b</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:11:48 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Avec Judith</category><title>Comprendre la relation franco-allemande, avec Hélène Miard-Delacroix</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/avec-judith/20261121-comprendre-la-relation-franco-allemande-avec-h%C3%A9l%C3%A8ne-miard-delacroix</link><description>
Comment expliquer la montée en puissance de l'AfD en Allemagne ? Le tandem franco-allemand est-il toujours aussi solide ? Comment expliquer que de moins en moins de jeunes français choisissent d'étudier l'allemand, et inversement ? La réponse à toutes ces questions avec l'invitée du jour du podcast "Avec Judith", Hélène Miard-Delacroix, germaniste et historienne française.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ff59369c-e45b-11f1-b374-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/Vignette-Judith-H%C3%A9l%C3%A8ne.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ff59369c-e45b-11f1-b374-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/Vignette-Judith-H%C3%A9l%C3%A8ne.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8e5ba4c2-e46d-11f1-b585-01f14c4fe190</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:05:41 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator></dc:creator></item><item><category>Sports</category><title>Ligue des nations : L'équipe de France retrouve l'Espagne en quarts</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/sports/20261121-ligue-des-nations-l-%C3%A9quipe-de-france-retrouve-l-espagne-en-quarts</link><description>
Voilà une occasion de prendre leur revanche. Battus par l'Espagne en demi-finale de la Coupe du monde, en juillet dernier, les Bleus retrouveront la Roja en quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations, en mars prochain.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/cd717224-e54c-11f1-8b74-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/ESPAGNE-FRANCE.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/cd717224-e54c-11f1-8b74-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/ESPAGNE-FRANCE.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8d108eee-e54d-11f1-bb08-f182e15d332d</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:00:01 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>L'Equipe TV</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Police : la présomption d'usage légal des armes entérinée au Parlement</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261121-police-la-pr%C3%A9somption-d-usage-l%C3%A9gal-des-armes-ent%C3%A9rin%C3%A9e-au-parlement</link><description>

Au sommaire de l'émission ce soir: la rencontre historique entre Xi Jinping, Vladimir Poutine et Donald Trump en marge du sommet de l'APEC; la guerre en Ukraine et les révélations de nos confrères de RFI sur la présence de soldats français sur le sol ukrainien, et le regain de tensions dans la guerre au Moyen-Orient, entre frappes iraniennes et offensive des Houthis au Yémen.

Les trois policiers ayant passé à tabac le producteur de musique noir Michel Zecler en 2020 ont été condamnés à des peines de un à deux ans de prison ferme. L'accusation avait de son côté requis, jeudi, entre quatre et six ans de prison ferme.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">844245cc-e52b-11f1-ab61-a5c9daa303ca</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 21:54:13 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg">© Benoit PEYRUCQ / AFP/Archives</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Au cœur de l’info, l’invité</category><title>Johann Chapoutot : "la dédiabolisation du RN est véritablement un mythe"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/au-c%C5%93ur-de-l-info-l-invit%C3%A9/20261120-johann-chapoutot-la-d%C3%A9diabolisation-du-rn-est-v%C3%A9ritablement-un-mythe</link><description>

Comment comprendre cette progression? Quelle est la responsabilité de la classe politique dans cette évolution? Quelles conséquences sur notre démocratie? Johann Chapoutot, Professeur d'Histoire contemporaine, auteur de "La bascule, Allemagne 1933" (éditions Gallimard), était l'Invité d'Au Coeur de l'Info. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20054536-e522-11f1-9d9f-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-200854-202823-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20054536-e522-11f1-9d9f-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-200854-202823-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">141cd51a-e525-11f1-8891-754dc11be848</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 20:58:03 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Achren VERDIAN</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Police : la loi sur la présomption de légitime défense définitivement adoptée par le Parlement</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-police-la-loi-sur-la-pr%C3%A9somption-de-l%C3%A9gitime-d%C3%A9fense-d%C3%A9finitivement-adopt%C3%A9e-par-le-parlement</link><description>
Vivement combattue dans la rue par ses opposants qui l'assimilent à un "permis de tuer", l'instauration d'une présomption d'usage légal des armes par les forces de l'ordre a été définitivement adoptée au Parlement vendredi soir, à la veille d'une nouvelle journée de mobilisation sociale.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/84d2817a-e524-11f1-9187-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C8TV3VK.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/84d2817a-e524-11f1-9187-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C8TV3VK.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec88460c-e514-11f1-8bce-43bc8e8d3f8d</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 19:02:24 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/84d2817a-e524-11f1-9187-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C8TV3VK.jpg">© Geoffroy van der Hasselt, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Fuites au ministère de l'Intérieur : comment le RN a progressivement séduit les hauts fonctionnaires</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-fuites-au-minist%C3%A8re-de-l-int%C3%A9rieur-comment-le-rn-a-progressivement-s%C3%A9duit-les-hauts-fonctionnaires</link><description>
Le parquet de Paris soupçonne l'ancien secrétaire général de Beauvau et actuel préfet du Loiret et de la région Centre-Val de Loire, Hugues Moutouh, d'avoir informé le Rassemblement national sur des enquêtes judiciaires visant le parti. Une affaire qui illustre l'influence grandissante du parti lepéniste dans les hautes sphères de l'État.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ed281fb0-e4ec-11f1-b121-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ed281fb0-e4ec-11f1-b121-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">845e625a-e4fb-11f1-8ece-9d792c6a9305</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:12:25 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ed281fb0-e4ec-11f1-b121-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg">© Pascal Guyot, AFP</source><dc:creator>Louis CHAHUNEAU</dc:creator></item><item><category>Outre-Mer</category><title>De l'océan Indien aux Caraïbes, la sécheresse frappe plusieurs territoires d'Outre-mer</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/outre-mer/20261120-de-l-oc%C3%A9an-indien-aux-cara%C3%AFbes-la-s%C3%A9cheresse-frappe-plusieurs-territoires-d-outre-mer</link><description>
La sécheresse s'installe durablement en Outre-mer. Le manque d'eau fragilise les cultures et menace les récoltes aux Antilles et à La Réunion. La situation est également très préoccupante en Guyane, où le niveau du fleuve continue de baisser.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">668bbe98-e4ca-11f1-b006-117a06c45e07</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:36:16 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator></dc:creator></item><item><category>ActuElles</category><title>Les féminicides, la partie émergée du contrôle coercitif</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/actuelles/20261120-les-f%C3%A9minicides-la-partie-%C3%A9merg%C3%A9e-du-contr%C3%B4le-coercitif</link><description>
Les féminicides font aussi des victimes invisibles : les proches des femmes assassinées, confrontées à un deuil impossible et à des embûches judiciaires. Dans 75 % des cas, le féminicide survient sans violences physiques préalables, mais au terme d'une période de contrôle coercitif :  une prison invisible faite d'emprise et de violences psychologiques, explique l'historienne Christelle Taraud, qui décrit des victimes "zombifiées" par leur tortionnaire.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">012b0ea0-e4e8-11f1-954f-b12e286687bf</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:46:33 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laure MANENT</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Gérard Depardieu et Michel Houellebecq accusés de viol en réunion et d'agressions sexuelles</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-g%C3%A9rard-depardieu-et-michel-houellebecq-accus%C3%A9s-de-viol-en-r%C3%A9union-et-d-agressions-sexuelles</link><description>

L'élue a balayé les accusations dans une interview sur BFMTV, arguant de faits vieux de "30 ans".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">00ba44a8-e4c1-11f1-9390-bd7bd8f937b3</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:26:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg">© Miguel Medina, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Dominique de Villepin candidat : un homme de droite populaire à gauche mais en quête d'électeurs</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-france-presidentielle-2027-dominique-de-villepin-homme-droite-populaire-gauche-sans-electeurs</link><description>

Jusqu'à deux ans de prison ferme ont été requis, jeudi à Paris, contre le fondateur du groupe Telegram "femmeblancherie" et six autres hommes, jugés pour des propos haineux visant notamment les femmes, dans le premier procès de la mouvance masculiniste en France.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/66fe4cc0-e45b-11f1-ab87-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-326Q46X.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/66fe4cc0-e45b-11f1-ab87-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-326Q46X.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">36382846-e45a-11f1-a6dc-e13af9138cc0</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 21:15:19 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/66fe4cc0-e45b-11f1-ab87-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-326Q46X.jpg">© AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Au procès Zecler, prison ferme requise contre les policiers, qui se défendent de tout racisme</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-au-proc%C3%A8s-zecler-prison-ferme-requise-contre-les-policiers-qui-se-d%C3%A9fendent-de-tout-racisme</link><description>
L'accusation a requis jeudi entre quatre et six ans de prison ferme contre les trois policiers ayant passé à tabac le producteur de musique noir Michel Zecler en 2020. La défense reconnait des "violences inadmissibles" mais conteste la lourdeur des peines requises et rejette toute dimension raciste.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0e8098a2-e445-11f1-9e16-9f17a13d179f</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:14:26 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg">© Benoit Peyrucq, AFP/Archives</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Présidentielle : les créateurs de contenus sommés de respecter le pluralisme par l'Arcom</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-cr%C3%A9ateurs-contenus-somm%C3%A9s-respecter-pluralisme-arcom</link><description>

En cas de manquements répétés, l'Arcom pourra décider de sanctions financières. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1246ec08-e430-11f1-b9da-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-32687U6.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1246ec08-e430-11f1-b9da-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-32687U6.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8d488a52-e42f-11f1-aa64-9157722348a5</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:07:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1246ec08-e430-11f1-b9da-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-32687U6.jpg">© Joël Saget, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Le RN visé par une nouvelle enquête autour de fuites impliquant un préfet</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-le-rn-vis%C3%A9-par-une-nouvelle-enqu%C3%AAte-autour-de-fuites-impliquant-un-pr%C3%A9fet</link><description>
À quelques mois de la présidentielle, le siège du Rassemblement national, ainsi que le ministère de l'Intérieur, ont été perquisitionnés par des juges d'instruction dans le cadre d'une nouvelle affaire judiciaire liée à des soupçons de fuites d'informations vers le RN, impliquant un préfet.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0cecf33c-e445-11f1-91e4-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/ec3a5b7b2f106b3dc8864450a3619a771fda0000.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0cecf33c-e445-11f1-91e4-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/ec3a5b7b2f106b3dc8864450a3619a771fda0000.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">4c941b6e-e440-11f1-92f2-af61307a37ad</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:40:23 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0cecf33c-e445-11f1-91e4-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/ec3a5b7b2f106b3dc8864450a3619a771fda0000.jpg">© Alain Jocard, AFP/Archives</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Les clés de l'info</category><title>"Femmeblancherie" : le procès de la haine des femmes</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/les-cl%C3%A9s-de-l-info/20261118-femmeblancherie-le-proc%C3%A8s-de-la-haine-des-femmes</link><description>
Ce mercredi s’est ouvert le procès de sept membres du canal Telegram "Femmeblancherie" au tribunal judiciaire de Paris. Appels aux féminicides et aux viols, fichages racistes et homophobes, plusieurs dizaines d’abonnés sont accusés d’une trentaine de crimes et délits, dont "provocation publique à commettre un crime". Un procès qui découle d’une idéologie très en vogue chez les jeunes, notamment sur les réseaux sociaux : le masculinisme.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3a6bb852-e3a5-11f1-b778-6d75ed565170/w:1024/p:16x9/FRAN261118-2339-Live-CS2339.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3a6bb852-e3a5-11f1-b778-6d75ed565170/w:1024/p:16x9/FRAN261118-2339-Live-CS2339.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">53cba342-e3a6-11f1-92ea-c561305b4ba1</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 23:18:12 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Cécile GALLUCCIO</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Présidentielle : Marine Tondelier "prête à travailler à une coalition" autour de Jean-Luc Mélenchon</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261118-presidentielle-2027-election-marine-tondelier-ecologistes-prete-travailler-coalition-autour-jean-luc-melenchon-la-france-insoumise-soutien</link><description>
Qualifiant la dynamique de campagne de Jean-Luc Mélenchon d'"indéniable", la candidate écologiste à la présidentielle, Marine Tondelier, a dit mercredi soir sur France 2 être "prête" à "travailler à une coalition" avec l'insoumis. Le candidat Raphaël Glucksmann a jugé qu'elle "[tournait] le dos" à "la tradition profondément proeuropéenne" des écologistes.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2fab2b82-e3a0-11f1-9252-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D7ED2CR.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2fab2b82-e3a0-11f1-9252-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D7ED2CR.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">474d52e2-e3a0-11f1-a2ae-77a83e8869af</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 22:39:24 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2fab2b82-e3a0-11f1-9252-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D7ED2CR.jpg">© Geoffroy Van Der Hasselt, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>"Les taxes, ils les boufferont" : Mélenchon et le controversé dîner avec des grands patrons</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261118-les-taxes-ils-les-boufferont-m%C3%A9lenchon-et-le-controvers%C3%A9-d%C3%AEner-avec-des-grands-patrons</link><description>
Le candidat de la France insoumise à l'élection présidentielle française de 2027, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, a dîné, mardi, avec les 13 plus grands patrons français. Un événement qui étonne pour le leader de la gauche radicale en rupture avec le capitalisme et fervent critique des ultra-riches.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f109998a-e396-11f1-b121-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-16T201716Z-1136734044-RC28POAG8YL6-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f109998a-e396-11f1-b121-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-16T201716Z-1136734044-RC28POAG8YL6-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d2d81b72-e372-11f1-a389-ad8030967382</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:09:31 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f109998a-e396-11f1-b121-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-16T201716Z-1136734044-RC28POAG8YL6-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS.jpg">© Kenzo Tribouillard, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>France : le comté du Fort des Rousses élu meilleur fromage du monde</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261118-france-le-comt%C3%A9-du-fort-des-rousses-%C3%A9lu-meilleure-fromage-du-monde</link><description>
Le meilleur fromage du monde a été désigné hier parmi les 5 000 produits en lice, une la quarantaine de pays en compétition. La médaille d'or a été décernée à un fromage français : le comté du fort des Rousses, petite commune près de la frontière suisse. Une consécration qui fait la fierté de toute la région.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/396b2754-e36d-11f1-8c50-7908c4e1a3c7/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-171130-171324-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/396b2754-e36d-11f1-8c50-7908c4e1a3c7/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-171130-171324-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3ea64eb0-e36d-11f1-8b87-310c2914a920</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:42:17 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>C'est en France</category><title>Élection présidentielle française 2027 – épisode 2 : le grand flou</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/c-est-en-france/20261118-%C3%A9lection-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-fran%C3%A7aise-2027-%E2%80%93-%C3%A9pisode-2-le-grand-flou</link><description>
Au printemps prochain, la France se rendra aux urnes pour élire un nouveau président de la République. Trente-huit candidats sont actuellement en lice et ont jusqu'au 12 mars pour obtenir 500 parrainages. Aujourd'hui, quels que soient les candidats, les sondages donnent Marine Le Pen en tête du premier et du second tour.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/4e62cfbc-e337-11f1-b040-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/confused-french.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/4e62cfbc-e337-11f1-b040-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/confused-french.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0794d444-e1cb-11f1-a708-c555493b4fb3</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:57:16 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Joanna COCKERELL</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Présidentielle 2027 : le candidat Édouard Philippe veut "oser des réformes radicales"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261118-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-le-candidat-%C3%A9douard-philippe-veut-oser-des-r%C3%A9formes-radicales</link><description>
Lors d'une conférence de presse de présentation de son programme pour l'élection présidentielle, Édouard Philippe a affirmé mercredi 18 novembre que "nous devons oser des réformes radicales, en rupture avec ce qui a été fait ces dernières années". Le candidat Horizons de nouveau affirmé son refus à l'idée de participer à une primaire de la droite. Les précisions de Flore Simon, chroniqueuse politique à France 24.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/7ab0c0c0-e359-11f1-9c83-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-141103-141859-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/7ab0c0c0-e359-11f1-9c83-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-141103-141859-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">82fa8cca-e359-11f1-a9a9-fb22cf0d552d</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:48:46 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Jeux vidéo : dernier jour d'attente avant la sortie de GTA VI en France</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261118-jeux-vid%C3%A9o-dernier-jour-d-attente-avant-la-sortie-de-gta-vi-en-france</link><description>
Treize années après son prédécesseur, "GTA VI" a commencé à déferler sur les consoles des joueurs du monde entier, impatients d'essayer le jeu vidéo le plus cher jamais développé et déjà le mieux noté de l'histoire de cette industrie. Le jeu affichait mercredi 18 novembre une moyenne de 99 sur 100 pour la centaine de critiques de la presse spécialisée recensées sur le site d'avis Metacritic, du jamais-vu. En France, la sortie est prévue pour le 19 novembre.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/835e5d70-e356-11f1-a655-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-135300-135449-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/835e5d70-e356-11f1-a655-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-135300-135449-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">897dfe2c-e356-11f1-87e1-eb4275e070c0</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:43:17 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>
